newsitem.title: USA: New York Iceni staff merge with new Gerald broker.
newsitem.headline: New York Iceni staff merge with new Gerald broker.

text.p: The two brokers at Iceni Commodities in New York have merged with Gerald Brokerage, a new division of Gerald Ltd, the London Metal Exchange ring dealing member, Gerald officials said.
Tony Ellis and Anil Shah join Terry Parsons, Christopher Hill, and Denise Price in Gerald's new division to trade and broker base metals in New York.
Iceni's Hamburg office, headed by Wolfgang Becker, closed at the end of last year.
Iceni's London office was also expected to close with the staff moving to ABN Amro Holding NV to set up a new LME brokerage team, trade sources said.
Ellis, Shah and the other Iceni traders previously worked at Merrill Lynch.
